parameters.query:
WITH expected_fields(field_index, field_key) AS (
    VALUES
        (1,  'procurement_subject'),
        (2,  'nm_price_with_vat'),
        (3,  'platform'),
        (4,  'procedure_type'),
        (5,  'application_deadline'),
        (6,  'application_review_date'),
        (7,  'results_date'),
        (8,  'customer'),
        (9,  'customer_contacts'),
        (10, 'participation_cost'),
        (11, 'participation_guarantee'),
        (12, 'evaluation_criteria'),
        (13, 'delivery_term'),
        (14, 'payment_terms'),
        (15, 'special_account_or_treasury'),
        (16, 'bank_support'),
        (17, 'government_contract'),
        (18, 'rebidding'),
        (19, 'national_regime'),
        (20, 'advance_contract_guarantee'),
        (21, 'warranty_obligations_guarantee'),
        (22, 'licenses_certificates'),
        (23, 'required_official_certificates'),
        (24, 'similar_supply_experience'),
        (25, 'analog_allowed'),
        (26, 'analog_definition'),
        (27, 'application_documents')
),

run_state AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        status
    FROM tender_analysis_runs
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
),

actual_fields AS (
    SELECT
        field_index,
        field_key,
        field_catalog_version,
        result_contract_version,
        status
    FROM tender_analysis_field_results
    WHERE analysis_run_id = $1::uuid
),

stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::int AS final_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status IN (
                'resolved',
                'requires_review',
                'not_found'
            )
        )::int AS valid_status_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE field_catalog_version = 'tender_fields_v1'
        )::int AS valid_catalog_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE result_contract_version = 'tender_field_final_v1'
        )::int AS valid_contract_count
    FROM actual_fields
),

missing_fields AS (
    SELECT ARRAY_AGG(
        e.field_key
        ORDER BY e.field_index
    ) AS keys
    FROM expected_fields e
    LEFT JOIN actual_fields a
        ON a.field_index = e.field_index
       AND a.field_key = e.field_key
    WHERE a.field_key IS NULL
),

unexpected_fields AS (
    SELECT ARRAY_AGG(
        a.field_key
        ORDER BY a.field_index
    ) AS keys
    FROM actual_fields a
    LEFT JOIN expected_fields e
        ON e.field_index = a.field_index
       AND e.field_key = a.field_key
    WHERE e.field_key IS NULL
),

invalid_status_fields AS (
    SELECT ARRAY_AGG(
        field_key
        ORDER BY field_index
    ) AS keys
    FROM actual_fields
    WHERE status NOT IN (
        'resolved',
        'requires_review',
        'not_found'
    )
),

invalid_catalog_fields AS (
    SELECT ARRAY_AGG(
        field_key
        ORDER BY field_index
    ) AS keys
    FROM actual_fields
    WHERE field_catalog_version <> 'tender_fields_v1'
),

invalid_contract_fields AS (
    SELECT ARRAY_AGG(
        field_key
        ORDER BY field_index
    ) AS keys
    FROM actual_fields
    WHERE result_contract_version <> 'tender_field_final_v1'
),

barrier AS (
    SELECT
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM run_state
        ) AS run_exists,

        (SELECT status FROM run_state LIMIT 1) AS run_status_before,

        s.final_count,

        COALESCE(m.keys, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS missing_keys,
        COALESCE(u.keys, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS unexpected_keys,
        COALESCE(ist.keys, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS invalid_status_keys,
        COALESCE(ic.keys, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS invalid_catalog_keys,
        COALESCE(irc.keys, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS invalid_contract_keys,

        (
            s.final_count = 27
            AND s.valid_status_count = 27
            AND s.valid_catalog_count = 27
            AND s.valid_contract_count = 27
            AND COALESCE(cardinality(m.keys), 0) = 0
            AND COALESCE(cardinality(u.keys), 0) = 0
        ) AS barrier_ready

    FROM stats s
    CROSS JOIN missing_fields m
    CROSS JOIN unexpected_fields u
    CROSS JOIN invalid_status_fields ist
    CROSS JOIN invalid_catalog_fields ic
    CROSS JOIN invalid_contract_fields irc
),

completion_claim AS (
    UPDATE tender_analysis_runs r
    SET
        status = 'completed',
        completed_at = COALESCE(r.completed_at, NOW()),
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM barrier b
    WHERE r.id = $1::uuid
      AND r.status = 'aggregating'
      AND b.barrier_ready = true
    RETURNING r.id
)

SELECT
    $1::uuid AS analysis_run_id,

    b.run_exists,
    b.run_status_before,
    b.final_count,
    b.barrier_ready,

    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM completion_claim
    ) AS completion_claimed,

    b.missing_keys,
    b.unexpected_keys,
    b.invalid_status_keys,
    b.invalid_catalog_keys,
    b.invalid_contract_keys,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT b.run_exists
            THEN 'run_not_found'

        WHEN b.barrier_ready
             AND b.run_status_before = 'ready_for_aggregation'
            THEN 'invalid_lifecycle_ready_for_aggregation'

        WHEN b.barrier_ready
             AND b.run_status_before NOT IN ('aggregating', 'completed')
            THEN 'invalid_lifecycle_status'

        WHEN b.barrier_ready
             AND b.run_status_before = 'completed'
            THEN 'already_completed'

        WHEN NOT b.barrier_ready
            THEN 'waiting_for_final_fields'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM completion_claim
        )
            THEN 'completed_now'

        ELSE 'completion_not_claimed'
    END AS finalization_state

FROM barrier b;
